headlines.title: Rubio takes behind-the-scenes role on Iran war while keeping his options open for the future
headlines.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio isn’t the face of the Iran negotiations. He’s kept a discreet public distance as the unpopular war grinds on.

headlines.title: Former ‘Alligator Alcatraz’ detainee says he was placed in phone booth-sized cage for 15 hours
headlines.description: For around 15 hours, immigration detention officers kept Raúl Suárez Herrero confined in a cage slightly larger than a phone booth, where he feared snakes and endured mosquitoes in the middle of Florida swampland, the former detainee alleged.

headlines.title: White House withdraws Trump’s nominee to lead ICE
headlines.description: The White House didn’t say why former Oklahoma state trooper Lance Schroyer was withdrawn from consideration.

headlines.title: Salvadorans with TPS don’t know how long their protections will last
headlines.description: José Palma of the National TPS Alliance says wrong paperwork or advice can jeopardize future immigration status as he argues immigrants here for 25 years should have a “permanent solution.”

headlines.title: Driver charged with 2nd-degree murder in L.A. bus crash that news helicopter was covering
headlines.description: Officials say Bailee Lynn Rios was intoxicated and driving against traffic when she slammed into a city bus. A news helicopter covering the deadly incident also crashed, killing three people.

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: Ohio mother of 16 kids found living in squalid home pleads not guilty to child endangerment
headlines.description: Elizabeth Siders, 34, also pleaded not guilty to charges of sexual battery and unlawful sexual conduct with a minor in a separate case.

headlines.title: F-16 fighter jet crashes in residential area in northern Michigan
headlines.description: The pilot safely ejected from the Texas Air National Guard jet in Grand Traverse County, and no injuries were reported on the ground.

headlines.description: The decision to grant Iranian leaders visas to travel to New York City for the annual meeting of global leaders comes seven months into the U.S. war with Iran.
